annotations.title: Generate all declared images in a deck

description: Fill in every AI-declared image in a deck at once. In the deck language, `image gen {prompt="misty harbor at dawn" x=… y=… w=… h=…}` places an image that renders as a placeholder until generated; this tool generates each one (honoring the theme's imageStyle) and wires the assets in. An archetype block's image slot with a prompt (`== fullBleedImage` with `image: harbor at dawn`) is filled the same way. Run it after create_deck/apply_deck when the document declared `image gen` elements or image slots. Requires the server to have an image model key configured. `imageSource` sets every image to a Pexels stock photo ("stock"), a generated picture ("genai", default) or the policy ("auto"). `overrides` sets one image's source ("stock" | "generate" | "auto") by slideId and elementId, and refills it even when it already has a picture, so stock photos can mix with the deck's imageStyle. A stock photo gets a Pexels credit in the slide's notes.
name: generate_deck_images
title: Generate all declared images in a deck
